title: Armstrong Powerbuilding
author: Jesse A.
desc: This program aims to build lean mass while also pushing you through strength plateaus. You need to have your diet and recovery on point. Be sure to eat at a modest surplus (~300-500 calories) at least and get your 8 hours of sleep.

ex.note:
5 warmup sets into 1 top set (1x1).

Top set. Focus on technique and explosive power.

3 working sets of 5 reps.

Sit back and down, keep your upper back tight to the bar.

3 warmup sets into 2 working sets.

These are intentionally light for shoulder stability and balance. Don't push these hard. Big bench day tomorrow.

2 warmup sets into 2 working sets of 8 reps.

Set the pins high, short ROM, use low bar position, set hips back and keep shins vertical.

1 warmup set into 4 working sets of 8-10 reps.

Brace against bench to minimize cheating.

5 warmup sets into 1 top set (1x1).

Strict 1 second pause on chest. Execute the set up and rep as perfectly as possible. Don't overhype. Focus.
Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on chest and explode up on each rep.

1 warmup set into 3 working sets.

Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to move the weight

1 warmup set into 4 working sets.

Lean against wall and maintain wall contact with head, hips and back. Keep elbows pinned at sides. Control the weight.
Don't go too heavy, focus on mind-muscle connection.

1 warmup set into 3 working sets.

Push these all very hard. Go to true failure.
Knees to chest, controlled reps, straighten legs more to increase difficulty.

3 warmup sets into 3 working sets.

This is a pin squat that starts and ends with the bar on the pins. At the bottom you're just above parallel. Get tight.

3 warmup sets into 3 working sets.

Shoulder width grip, tuck your elbows in closer to your sides.

1 warmup set into 4 working sets.

Pull your elbows down against your sides.

1 warmup set into 3 working sets.

Arc the weight behind your head. Constant tension on triceps.

5 warmup sets into 1 top set (1x1).

Brace your lats, chest tall, pull the slack out of the bar before lifting.
1 second pause right after plates leave the floor.
Focus on contracting your delts to move the weight, don't let form get sloppy toward the end of the set!

1 warmup set into 4 working sets.

Mind-muscle connection with rear delts

1 warmup set into 3 working sets.

Keep constant tension on the lats. Big stretch at the top by leaning slightly forward.

1 warmup set into 4 working sets.

Keep elbows locked in place, squeeze the dumbbell handle hard!

4 warmup sets into 4 working sets.

Sit back and down, keep your upper back tight to the bar.

4 warmup sets into 4 working sets.

Set up a comfortable arch, quick pause on chest and explode up on each rep

1 warmup set into 3 working sets.

Be mindful of lower back fatgiue, stay light and minimize cheating.
Machine, band or weighted, squeeze and hold for 1 second at the top of each rep.
